decisions.reason: The About page currently presents Aave prize-pool yield generation as active technology and a key feature, so those references become obsolete when the integration is removed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
cool.
I can release phase 2 payment today, but we will still need to update the FAQs and then do Transak in a couple days.
And we will still need to do thorough testing (no referral code tests, block pool prize trigger tests, fiat payment tests, email link etc) and I'll need to upload the ebook PDF and test all that too.
And a lot of wording tweaks on the site.
Okay?

And I'd like to add/update the hero section on home (above the fold) with something like this copy/layout.

Hero Headline: Dropout multimillionaire to zero in a flash. Now rebuilding — rewarding affiliates and building a network to free creators from Amazon KDP's 70% cut.

Sub-Headline: "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal" — Unlimited NFT book ⋅ $15 forever ⋅ Base.
Mechanics Tease: Buy → own the book + get your referral link. Refer → instant & unlimited $5 + prize draw tickets.
CTA Button: Mint for $15
And the book cover integrated on the landing page.

technology_highlights: Audited, secure Solidity smart contracts on Base
Chainlink VRF for provably fair prize draws
Base Network for low fees, fast transactions, and Ethereum security
Fully on-chain logic with initial V1 safeguards and planned evolution toward full decentralization
key_features_copy: Fair prize selection through Chainlink VRF

decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield does not change the Big Block prize amount, winner count, sales trigger, or pool-funding rules.
The Aave removal does not change automatic prize transfer to the winner wallet.
Removing prize-pool yield does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw condition, or funding sources.
Aave yield is independent of Chainlink VRF winner selection, ticket weighting, and draw eligibility.
The removal does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw reset behavior.
Secondary royalties may continue funding the prize pools without those funds being deposited into Aave.
Primary-mint proceeds can still be allocated to the Small and Big Block pools; only the separate yield mechanism is removed.
Public unauthenticated access to pool values and leaderboards remains valid without Aave integration.
The Transak fiat-mint flow is independent of prize-pool yield generation.
The hero content mentions referral commissions and prize tickets but makes no Aave or yield claim.
Email delivery, confirmation content, reading links, and winner notifications remain unchanged by removal of Aave.
